title: Philippines Bank Lending
thesis: A fictional Philippine bank tracks its retail and MSME loan book on Snowflake: daily repayments become on-time and PAR 30 KPIs, a 14-day missed-instalment risk score, deposit-inflow anomalies and grounded AI answers, all from curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: On-time repayment, missed instalments, PAR 30 and outstanding for 200 borrowers in Quezon City, Cebu City, Davao City, Iloilo City and Cagayan de Oro.
Each KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so every figure traces back to borrower-day rows.
The product chart compares Salary, Personal, MSME, Auto and Agri-Fishery loans by missed instalments.
tabs.call_out: One governed view of the loan book, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which borrowers should the collections desk call first?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification gives each borrower a probability of missing an instalment in the next 14 days.
Precision and recall come from the most recent 14 labelled days, shown next to the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags falls in each borrower’s deposit-account inflows; the forecast projects missed instalments for the next 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Evaluated ML that runs where the loan data lives

talking_points: Promise-to-pay rate, document coverage and pending documents show where collections and loan files fall short.
Internal credit score against missed instalments shows an association, not a cause.
The action memo proposes three prioritised actions using only the KPI, borrower, product and risk tables.
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens the moment an instalment is missed?

talking_points: Repayment events arrive in RAW.LIVE_REPAYMENTS from the native simulator, or from Amazon Data Firehose through S3 and Snowpipe.
The alert logs each MISSED event with its collection playbook and current risk band, then emails the collections lead.
tabs.call_out: From a missed instalment to a collection action on one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent answers metric questions with Cortex Analyst over the semantic view and cites 15 synthetic collection playbooks through Cortex Search.
Every answer shows its generated SQL and the playbook IDs it used.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: One core, two builds: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake with Data Firehose, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q.
All data shown is synthetic and rebuilds the same way from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
